source.note: Seed baseline mirrored from ingest.py's COMMANDER_NAME_ALIASES; this environment cannot reach api.scryfall.com to run generate_commander_oracle_aliases.py directly. Regenerate with `uv run --project packages/backend python packages/backend/src/generate_commander_oracle_aliases.py` (from the repo root; or `uv run python src/generate_commander_oracle_aliases.py` from inside packages/backend) from an environment with Scryfall network access to pick up new Universes Beyond alternate-name printings. The script's default --output path resolves relative to its own location, so either invocation writes to packages/backend/data/commander_oracle_aliases.json.
